license_nft_mint: <base58 License NFT mint of the operating license>
release_master_nft_mint: <base58 master mint: the estate profile's anchors.masterMint>
_comment_store_authority: OMIT store_authority until the governed StoreReleaseListing bootstrap has created an exact Active listing for every served release. Adding the StoreOperatorAuthorization.store_authority public key enables that target-scoped policy.
program_id: <base58 license-registry program: the estate profile's programs.license-registry.programId>
_comment_root_store_url: Reseller stores only: the root Store origin this Store mirrors. There is no default; omit it on a root Store.
rpc_fallback_urls: <independently trusted endpoint for the same cluster>
_comment_store_link_control_mtls: REQUIRED when policy.require_pearl_control_for_app_publish=true. This is a private listener for the Store Link; do not route it through the public catalog edge. The SHA-256 is over the Store Link client certificate DER, not a Pearl public key or CA certificate.

store_link_control_mtls.store_link_client_cert_sha256: <lowercase sha256 of Store Link client certificate DER>

boot_identity._comment: OMIT this block for a READ-ONLY store (operator nil, legacy /publish 503 or 410 after Pearl cutover). Set it to enable governed app publishing (B1-02). DEPLOYER MUST also register an Active on-chain SidecarIdentityEntry (register_sidecar_identity) pinning the derived signing/encryption pubkeys + this store's domain hash, sha256(tls cert DER), and the binary hash. At every start the Store also requires its own approval cascade for sidecar_id under license_nft_mint (LicenseEntry naming release_master_nft_mint, Global and Local approvals pinning the binary hash, reseller approval, ResellerEntry) to be Active.
